scope: url4 2.0 breaking change: the three prior tests that pinned the 1.x meaning of a URI intent (CH8-CH10 in docs/spec/2026-10-09-url4-rds-code-pointer/prd/rds-code-pointer.md section 7.1), plus one comment in test_characterization.py that names the module the parity note moved to.

Each flipped test keeps its scenario and asserts the 2.0 behavior; no other prior test changes.
